title: Formalizing Extended Complex Numbers, Mobius Transformations, and Cross Ratio in Lean 4
summary: The extended complex plane is a fundamental object in complex analysis, hyperbolic geometry, and mathematical physics. Its geometry is governed by Möbius transformations, with the cross ratio serving as a central invariant. We present a formalization of these concepts in the Lean4 theorem prover. The extended complex plane is represented using Mathlib's Option type over $\mathbb{C}$, where the additional element represents the point at infinity.
